// UseVault: Single real environment: this app always talks to the self-hosted Vault. Set VAULT_ADDR / VAULT_TOKEN env vars and Vault:SecretPath below.
// ConnectionStrings:Default / Eniboard:: Only read when UseVault is false (ad-hoc local run without Vault, e.g. ConnectionStrings__Default / Eniboard__JwtSigningKey env vars). Never used when UseVault is true.
// GitHub:*: GitHub:WebhookSecret must match the secret configured on the GitHub webhook.
// Cors:FrontendOrigin: The deployed frontend origin, e.g. https://eniboard.vercel.app
// ForwardedHeaders:KnownProxies/KnownNe: KnownProxies: extra reverse-proxy IPs; KnownNetworks: extra reverse-proxy CIDR ranges (e.g. 172.17.0.0/16 for a Docker bridge). Loopback is always trusted. If your proxy is not trusted, every client shares one login rate-limit bucket.
